configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Default Windows preset. MSBuild finds its own toolchain — no vcvars needed.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc
configurePresets.description: Faster incremental builds with MSVC. Requires a Developer Command Prompt (or sourcing vcvars64.bat) before running.

configurePresets.name: mingw
configurePresets.description: GCC via MinGW Makefiles. Requires gcc / g++ / mingw32-make on PATH (MSYS2, w64devkit, CLion-bundled, etc.).

configurePresets.name: ninja-gcc
configurePresets.description: Faster builds with GCC. Requires gcc / g++ / ninja on PATH.
